# cpp-httplib

Vendored from upstream `cpp-httplib` tag `v0.14.3`.

Upstream: https://github.com/yhirose/cpp-httplib

This copy is used by the EGS REST API so the server target builds without requiring a system-wide development package install. The Ubuntu `libcpp-httplib-dev` package splits declarations and implementation across a header and shared library, so the upstream single-header release is used here.
